summary: Rapides Parish tower named on a 1951 USGS topographic map; no source read says whether it still stands or is open.

events.note: Named as the Plainview Lookout Tower on a USGS topographic map portrayed as 1951 and published 1952, as catalogued by Pastmaps; shows the tower existed by then, not its build date

Plainview Lookout Tower named near Plainview school on the 1951 map
evidence.quote: The presence of the Plainview Lookout Tower near Plainview Sch highlights the critical role of fire watch in this forested region where Vernon, Rapides, and Allen Parishes meet.

notes_for_editor: The only dated evidence is a Pastmaps catalogue entry for a 1951 USGS map; the map sheet itself was not opened, so the landmark note is as Pastmaps describes it. No build date, height, design, status, staffing, or access appears in any source read. Pastmaps's summary says the area is where Vernon, Rapides and Allen parishes meet, while the Forest Lookouts page places the tower in Rapides Parish; treat the parish as Rapides, per the page. The Forest Lookouts state list spells the name PLAINVEW. The agency correction is a proposal for a human to review. No NHLR or FFLOS listing in the cached registers. Statewide fire-tower context (1915 funding; 1950 count of 56) is from Wikipedia, whose history section cites sources this run could not confirm; it describes the state network, not this tower.
